_comment: Image-only demonstration card: DINOv2 is a pure image encoder, so encode_texts is unsupported and zero-shot text classification is unavailable. Classification requires few-shot reference images: pass `references` per label in the request. Runs classify-only with no segmenter, so it is CPU-eligible (MODAL_VISION_GPU=none).
_comment_prompt_template: Image-only encoders ignore prompt_template; leave it empty. Classification requires reference images.
